title: False Information Provided to Secure Primary School Places
what_it_is: False Information Provided to Secure Primary School Places

sections.label: False information school registration cases
sections.summary: Fewer than 10 reported cases in 10 years; MOE refers suspected false information to Police, and convicted parents' children transfer schools.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: In the last 10 years, there were less than 10 such reported cases.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: Where there is reason to believe that false information may have been used, MOE will refer the case to the Police for their investigation and action.

sentences.speaker: The Minister for Education (Schools) (Mr Ng Chee Meng)
sentences.text: In cases where the verdict is finalised and the parent is convicted of the charge, the child who was previously registered in a school based on false information would be transferred to another school with available vacancies.

sections.label: Support for affected child
sections.summary: Educational and emotional support will be extended to the affected child if needed.

sentences.speaker: Mr Ng Chee Meng
sentences.text: Yes, if needed, we will extend the necessary support both educationally and emotionally to the child affected.
